bot.deleted:
{role} was deleted by {by}.
It can be created again, with its members and channel permissions, in the dashboard: **Role backup**.

web.how: Every hour, Kron notes the server’s roles (name, colour, permissions, place), who has them, and the roles’ permissions in each channel. Nothing is stored when nothing changed.
web.ownerHint: Server owner only: a staff member who damaged the roles can neither turn this module off nor restore over it.
web.ownerOnly: This page is for the server owner (or Administrators, when the owner allows it).
web.snapshotsHint: Pick a backup from before the problem, then “Compare”: Kron shows what it would repair, without changing anything.
web.empty: No backup yet: turn the module on, the first one comes within a minute, or click “Back up now”.
web.nothing: Nothing to repair: the server is as in this backup.
web.left: {count} member(s) of this backup left the server: Discord cannot bring them back.
web.safe: A restore never removes anything: it creates, repairs and gives back. A backup of the current state is made just before. Kron settings that pointed at a deleted role follow the new role.
web.confirm: I want to restore this backup
web.restored: Restore done: {created} role(s) created, {repaired} repaired, {members} member(s), {overwrites} channel permission(s). Failures: {failed}.
web.restoreFailed: The restore failed: check the Kron role is at the very top and try again.
web.alertHint: When a role is deleted, Kron writes there who did it.
web.allowAdmins: Server Administrators can use this page too
web.allowAdminsHint: Only the owner can change this.
